obernants.observation_scope: Return values, explicit state and named assertions
obernants.operator: Universe: candidate implementation behaviors on this file's exact fixtures paired with normal/panic outcomes. Normal completion is absent when subset_zeta's independently computed tree/pair/submask expectation differs from actual, when a literal differs, or when error precedence/state preservation differs. Inputs outside these fixtures impose no test constraint; this complements the explicit assertion relation only.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived mathematical target; finite correspondence, not a proof
obernants.assumptions: Lawful ordering where applicable; stated numeric bounds; no allocator fault injection
